incidents.title: Indexer lag after Soroban RPC upgrade

updates.message: Indexer lag exceeded 5 minutes. Bet totals may appear stale.
Upstream RPC provider rotated nodes and our event cursor was rejected as out of retention range.
Cursor reset to the oldest retained ledger; backfill in progress.
Indexer is fully caught up. No funds were affected.

postMortem.summary: For 95 minutes the indexer stopped ingesting events, causing stale market totals in the UI. On-chain state and user funds were never at risk.
postMortem.rootCause: The RPC provider upgrade reduced event retention; the persisted cursor pointed to a pruned ledger and the poller retried indefinitely without alerting.
postMortem.resolution: Reset the cursor to the oldest retained ledger and backfilled from Horizon.
actionItems: Alert when indexer lag exceeds LAG_ALERT_THRESHOLD_S for more than 2 minutes
Automatically fall back to the oldest retained ledger when the cursor is pruned
Publish incidents on the public status page
